newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-AUSTRIA'S PFEIFENBERGER TO MISS CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRIA'S PFEIFENBERGER TO MISS CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Austria will again have to do without Werder Bremen forward Heimo Pfeifenberger in next week's World Cup qualifier against Estonia in Vienna.
Pfeifenberger, who also missed Austria's loss to Scotland earlier this month, is still nursing a broken toe.
Austrian coach Herbert Prohaska on Tuesday made several changes to the 18-man squad which will confront Estonia in a group four match on April 30.
He has replaced midfielders Franz Aigner and Michael Hatz and forward Andreas Ogris with SV Salzburg's Adi Huetter, Rapid Vienna's Didi Kuehbauer and 1860 Munich's Harald Cerny.
"The changes were done for only one reason -- to make the squad more offensive," said Prohaska. "A victory against Estonia brings us one step closer to our goal of qualifying for the World Cup."
Kuehbauer, missing in Scotland due to personal tragedy, rejoins the squad although his wife Michaela is still in a coma following a car crash.
Goalkeepers - Michael Konsel (Rapid Vienna), Franz Wohlfahrt (VfB Stuttgart)
Defenders - Wolfgang Feiersinger (Borussia Dortmund), Walter Kogler (SV Salzburg), Anton Pfeffer (Austria Vienna), Peter Schoettel (Rapid Vienna)

Midfielders - Andreas Heraf (Rapid Vienna), Andreas Herzog (Werder Bremen), Adi Huetter (SV Salzburg), Didi Kuehbauer (Rapid Vienna), Roman Maehlich (Sturm Graz), Markus Schopp (Hamburg SV), Peter Stoeger (Rapid Vienna)
Forwards - Harald Cerny (1860 Munich), Anton Polster (Cologne), Dieter Ramusch (Casino Graz), Ivica Vastic (Sturm Graz), Arnold Wetl (FC Porto).
